hypothesis: Training the SOL TabM-flat entry model as a multi-task network -- shared BatchEnsemble trunk with the parent 3-class soft race-conviction head PLUS two per-side TP-first binary heads, optimized jointly -- improves the fresh-forward stack over the frozen parent (VAL +0.65% / OOS +4.08%), where rev2 showed the same quality signal FAILS as a post-hoc external gate. Mechanism claim: joint optimization regularizes the shared representation and calibrates the direction probabilities, instead of deleting trades after the fact.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: Rev2 (same day) closed the post-hoc quality-gate design: every external LightGBM TP-first gate level reduced VAL PnL on this exact parent. That verdict does not settle the joint-training question -- a post-hoc gate can only remove trades from a frozen decision stream, while joint training changes the decision stream itself; BTC's quality-stack failures were likewise all post-hoc or two-stage, never a single-trunk multi-task fit against the corrected TB label.
research.retest_design: Same panel, label, splits, purge+embargo, standardization, costs, and 5 contract seeds as the parent survey. Grid pre-registered and closed: lambda in {0.25, 1.0} (quality-BCE weight) x entry rules {side_prob_055 (parent-frozen), side_prob_055 AND own-quality>=0.45, side_prob_055 AND own-quality>=0.50} = 6 configs, selected on seed-mean VAL PnL with >=15 seed-mean trades. Early stop on the model's own joint VAL loss. Gate: best config must beat the parent baseline VAL +0.65% to earn ONE OOS read; OOS adoption additionally requires seed-mean OOS > 0 with >=3/5 seeds positive. If the VAL gate fails, the joint-quality axis closes with no OOS read.

model.candidate_architecture: JointTabM: shared 8-expert BatchEnsemble trunk (128x3) with 3-class soft-KL direction head + 2 per-side TP-first BCE heads, loss = KL + lambda*BCE

selection.validation_pass_criteria: best of the 6 pre-registered configs on seed-mean VAL PnL must exceed the frozen parent baseline +0.6507% with seed-mean trades >= 15; single OOS read for that config only; OOS adoption requires seed-mean > 0 and >=3/5 seeds positive
